content: Supabase Auth + Next.js: Use @supabase/ssr (not deprecated auth-helpers) for App Router. Install @supabase/supabase-js + @supabase/ssr. Auth uses cookie-based sessions. Use supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() for email/password login. Middleware checks cookies for protected route redirects. Server pages use supabase.auth.getUser() — no manual token logic. For a single-user personal app, Supabase Auth is the clear choice when already on Supabase — avoids adding a separate auth layer and integrates naturally with RLS. Free tier: 50,000 MAU.
